newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures slip, on large deliveries.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures slip, on large deliveries.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower on Wednesday, as the large number of deliveries at the spot expiry pressured the market, traders said.

The spot April contract expired at noon at 128.0 yen per kg, up 1.7 yen from the precious day, with 1,423 lots of deliveries. Other prices ranged from 1.8 yen to 3.4 yen per kg lower, with benchmark September ending down 3.4 yen at 133.6 yen.
"Although the spot April contract expired higher on short-covering for position-adjustments, sentiment remains bearish on looming ample near-term supplies," one trader said.
